verdict.rationale: Spline documents no-code interactivity built from states, events and actions, and supports multiple scenes that can be linked with a Scene Transition action. That covers triggers and screen-to-screen transitions without code. Its 2D Hana canvas is aimed at interfaces with states and interactions, but the evidence frames this as interactive 3D/2D experiences rather than screen-flow prototyping. Missing for 10: any evidence of overlays or modals, explicit screen/frame prototype linking in the 2D editor, transition type options, and independent hands-on corroboration of prototyping workflows.
